notes.title: Patch 1.5

tags.bug: [b]Newspaper glitch fixed:[/b] You can't press E while looking at the newspapers;

tags.balance_change: [b]Buffed Swampmonster:[/b] In the level where Swampmonster tries to get you, made him a bit faster, so you can't escape by just walking;

tags.bug: [b]Added temporary error fixes in the gas station first levels:[/b] If you encounter a major bug, you get a screen to restart the level where you were in;

tags.feature: [b]Added a new secret ending:[/b] In the level where you made a mistake (by choosing the wrong option with the customers) you can find a secret room.

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content: Few fixes to a few bugs I got from the feedback on my Discord server, made a small change to the Main Menu so the intro at the start that showcases ''Goatzy Games'' and ''The Last Customer'' plays once every time you open the game, people didn't seem to like it, and also an Ending on the level ''Home'' was fixed, didn't work when you actually should have completed the mission to get the reward of the Ending.
